geographic_universe: 3144 Census 2025 counties and county equivalents in the 50 states and District of Columbia

fields.name: state
fields.definition: Two-character state abbreviation derived from the FIPS prefix.

fields.name: median_hh_income
fields.definition: ACS 2024 five-year B19013_E001 median household income; negative Census sentinels are null.

fields.name: rucc_2023
fields.definition: USDA Rural-Urban Continuum Code 2023, integer 1 through 9.

fields.name: rural
fields.definition: Atlas dichotomy: true exactly when rucc_2023 is 4 or greater.

fields.name: n_cardiologists
fields.definition: Distinct qualifying NPIs assigned to the county from the canonical provider-location table.

fields.name: miles_to_nearest_cardiologist
fields.definition: One-decimal great-circle miles from the Census county internal point to the nearest canonical qualifying-provider location; not road distance or travel time.

fields.name: n_hospitals
fields.definition: Distinct valid CMS Facility IDs independently assigned to the county.

fields.name: n_cah
fields.definition: Distinct assigned numeric-CCN facilities with normalized Hospital Type exactly CRITICAL ACCESS HOSPITALS.

fields.name: n_cah_20plus_miles_to_nearest_cardiologist
fields.definition: Distinct evaluable CAH facilities in the county whose unrounded facility-to-nearest-provider distance is at least 20.0 miles.

fields.name: hpsa_primary_care
fields.definition: At least one retained county-associated primary-care HPSA record has an included normalized status; not a cardiology HPSA designation.

fields.name: chd_age_adjusted_prevalence_pct
fields.definition: CDC PLACES 2025 release, estimate year 2023, CHD/AgeAdjPrv model-based adult coronary-heart-disease prevalence percent; suppressed or absent values are null.
